simple.meaning: טָעָה (ṭâʻâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to wander ; causatively to lead astray.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Ezekiel, beginning at Ezekiel 13:10. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to טָעָה (H2937) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: טָעָה (ṭâʻâh) / H2937 is traced through Ezekiel 13:10 with source-language evidence and verse context.
